chunks: Sufficient is Allah and His Word as perfection.

There is no god but Allah, alone, without partner; to Him belongs the dominion and to Him belongs the praise; He gives life and causes death, and He is the Ever-Living who does not die; in His hand is all good, and He is over all things competent.

key_terms.بِيَدِهِ الْخَيْرُ: In His hand is all good
key_terms.يُحْيِي وَيُمِيتُ: He gives life and causes death

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the concluding creedal formula in Kamal al-Din?
ai.summary: This declaration, known as the *Tasdiq* or *Shahada*, serves as a foundational creedal statement in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Kamal al-Din*, affirming Allah’s absolute unity (*Tawhid*) and sovereignty. It emphasizes divine attributes such as life, power, and goodness, often concluding hadith narratives to reinforce theological certainty. This formula is pivotal in Shia scholarship for establishing the core tenets of faith and the infallibility of the Imams as divine proof.
